claim: Zwolle to Amsterdam Schiphol by train averages 1h22m, with fastest services at 1h10m, around 97 trains per day on the 93 km route operated mostly by NS.
quote: The average journey time by train between Zwolle and Amsterdam Schiphol Airport is 1 hour 22 minutes, with around 97 trains per day. The journey time may be longer on weekends and holidays; use the search form on this page to search for a specific travel date.

claim: Trains from Zwolle to Amsterdam Centraal take on average 1h18m with fastest services around 1h06m, roughly 75 trains per day over the 82 km route.
quote: The average journey time by train between Zwolle and Amsterdam-Centraal is 1 hour 18 minutes, with around 75 trains per day.

claim: OV-fiets is available at both Zwolle Centraal and Zwolle Hanzeland stations for a flat daily rate, with operating hours roughly 05:05–01:30.
quote: Renting an OV-fiets is super easy. You just rent the bike at one of the more than 300 rental locations. You can use the bike for 24 hours.

claim: Deelfiets Nederland provides around 50 e-bikes for hire at the renovated Zwolle station, available on both sides of the tracks.
quote: Op Station Zwolle staan ongeveer 50 elektrische deelfietsen. De fietsen staan aan beide zijden van het station.

claim: Zwolle's centre is split into three parking tariff zones (zone 1 highest, zone 2 mid, zone 3 lowest); main central garages include Q-Park Maagjesbolwerk under Mediamarkt, Katwolderplein under Pathé (voted best garage in NL with a 9 rating), and Noordereiland near De Librije.
quote: The center of Zwolle is divided into three different zones: zone 1 is the area closest to the center where you pay the highest rate, zone 2 is the area west of the center where you pay the 'middle rate', and zone 3 is the area east of the center where you pay the lowest rate.

claim: Late May in Zwolle averages 18°C daytime / 8°C night with ~8.1 hours of sun and roughly 11 rainy days; June rises to 20°C/11°C with about 12 rainy days.
quote: In May, Zwolle enjoys an average high of 18°C (64°F) during the day and 8°C (47°F) at night, with about 11 rainy days. June marks the arrival of summer with daytime temperatures averaging 20°C (69°F).

claim: Zwolle Unlimited 2026 — a free outdoor cultural festival at the Thorbeckegracht / Pelserkade waterfront — runs Friday 29 May through Sunday 7 June 2026, with eight themed days covering choir, world music, blues, Afrobeat, a children's festival Nemia and a craft market.
quote: Zwolle Unlimited - 29 mei 2026 - 7 jun 2026. Het is gratis toegankelijk voor iedereen.

claim: Bilderberg Grand Hotel Wientjes is a 4-star historic hotel near Zwolle's railway station, with helpful staff, bicycle rentals and Wi-Fi, well-rated across 1,700+ reviews though some guests note dated furnishings and pricey breakfast.
quote: Bilderberg Grand Hotel Wientjes in Zwolle is a stylish 4-star hotel close to the city centre and railway station, with bike rental and a charming café.

claim: Pillows Grand Boutique Hotel Ter Borch occupies a 19th-century former police station directly opposite Zwolle station with 41 rooms, Coperto Restobar (14/20 Gault&Millau), gym, sauna and 15 paid parking spaces.
quote: Located in a 19th-century former police station, just a few minutes' walk from Zwolle station and the city centre. The hotel features 41 rooms and suites. Coperto Restobar has been awarded with a 14/20 score by Gault&Millau.

claim: Lumen Hotel Zwolle is a 4-star design hotel rated 8.6/10 across 3,633 reviews with high staff-friendliness (9.2), but sits about 2.8 km from the historic centre — best for guests with a car or bike.
quote: Hotel Lumen is a four-star hotel with a beautiful design. Rated 8.6 from 3,633 reviews. The 2.8 km distance to the city center might be a bit far for some.

claim: Zwolle's VVV tourist office is housed in 'De Hoofdwacht' on Grote Markt 20, in the heart of the old town, with a secondary info point Het Zwolse Balletjeshuis at Grote Kerkplein 13.
quote: VVV Zwolle (Tourist Office) is located at 'De Hoofdwacht' Grote Markt 20, NL-8011 LV Zwolle.

claim: The Wine Festival Zwolle returns to Grote Kerkplein on 5 June with wine merchants and international selections, while Liberation Festival (5 May, Park de Wezenlanden) draws 130,000 visitors annually but precedes a 29–31 May weekend trip.
quote: Wine Festival Zwolle is organized on June 5 on the Grote Kerkplein, where wine specialists, wine stores and bottles of wine from all over the world are gathered. Liberation Day was again one big party in Zwolle, attracting over 130,000 visitors annually.

claim: Zwolle Unlimited 2026 was confirmed to go ahead at the kade after a public crowdfunding push, with programming organised by Productiehuis De Verhalenboot at Pletterstraat 20.
quote: Publiek geeft gul: Zwolle Unlimited 2026 gaat definitief door aan de kade.
